transcript.text: Hi everyone. We're approaching the readiness review for the real-time collaboration service launch on Monday at 09:00 UTC. Before we finalize the launch plan, I want to make sure backend engineering, reliability, privacy, and customer success each get their separate final check-in. Let's go around and hear any concerns or sign-offs from each area.

transcript.text: I need to raise a concern before we finalize the launch plan. While investigating an unrelated mobile performance report this afternoon, I confirmed that mobile clients resume from background in bursts and currently retry every 5 seconds, which can create a reconnect storm. The rollout policy should set the retry interval to exactly 30 seconds. I have not yet filed the client-library ticket for this.

transcript.text: I need to flag a capacity concern. About 20 minutes ago I completed a production-traffic replay and confirmed that the collaboration cluster's safe connection ceiling for Monday is exactly 6,000 concurrent connections — not the 10,000 currently in the draft plan. The autoscaling limit hasn't been updated yet because I'm still attaching the replay results to the capacity worksheet, but the draft plan needs to be revised before we finalize it.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to raise a privacy concern before we finalize the launch plan. I completed a privacy review this morning and confirmed two requirements: first, collaboration content for EU accounts must remain in the EU processing region — the current draft plan stores all collaboration data in the primary production region, which would violate this. Second, session transcripts must be deleted after exactly 30 days, not the 90 days currently in the draft plan. I haven't opened the compliance ticket yet because legal was still reviewing the wording, but these changes need to be reflected in the launch plan before we finalize it.

transcript.text: I need to raise a customer-success concern before we finalize the launch plan. I reconciled the customer-success rollout spreadsheet an hour ago and confirmed that six accounts — acct-204, acct-219, acct-233, acct-241, acct-278, and acct-301 — have administrator opt-out commitments until their enablement sessions are complete.
